stage1.name: Stage 1: spatial block CV
details: Pooled out-of-fold predictions from 5 spatial holdout folds; simulated mechanical negatives enter training only and are excluded from evaluation and calibration holdouts. Metrics here describe the raw constrained XGBoost score; Stage 2 describes the ungated isotonic event-buffer score, a different estimand from live gated scores.

Training includes temporal inventory-absence pseudo-negatives and simulated mechanical controls. Simulated rows are excluded from calibration and validation holdouts; negative observations are not field-verified.

confidence_intervals.method: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap of fixed predictions; conditional on fitted models; not retraining uncertainty

stage2.name: Stage 2: historical catastrophe hindcast
details: 48 event-time rows across 24 held-out case(s); Recall@K uses the top 10% by predicted probability (K=5); Recall@40 also reported with its actual K. Stable input order breaks tied scores. On small samples Recall@40 can be uninformative.

confidence_intervals.method: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap of fixed predictions; conditional on fitted models; not retraining uncertainty

readiness_scope: Engineering and invariant audit only; randomized audit must also pass. Empirical results are descriptive.

publication_metadata.change: Only embedded raw EONET record arrays summarized; checks, metrics, timestamps, fingerprints and readiness flags unchanged.
